test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

We have the responsibility __of finding our__ daughter.
solution:
The correct answer is** No improvement required. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the underlined segment of the sentence, **no improvement or correction is required.**
 
• The given sentence is talking about the** responsibility of the parents to find their daughter. **
 
• The given sentence is given in the **Present Tense.**
 
• **Responsibility: **Something that you have a duty to handle.
 
 
• **Example:** *Who has the responsibility of decorating the school? *
